name: meter
description: A single line text meter like the CPU and memory bars of htop and btop.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to display in the meter

config.name: label
config.label: Label
config.description: The text in front of the bar. Defaults to the metric name

config.name: hide_label
config.label: Hide Label
config.description: Hides the label so the bar uses the full width

config.name: label_width
config.label: Label Width
config.description: The width of the label in characters. Longer labels are cut off. Defaults to the length of the label

config.name: style
config.label: Style
config.description: htop draws pipes inside brackets with the value in the bar, btop draws squares with the value behind the bar, blocks draws a smooth bar with partial blocks, top draws the value in front of a plain bar

config.name: hide_value
config.label: Hide Value
config.description: Hides the formatted value

config.name: hide_unit
config.label: Hide Unit
config.description: Shows the value without its unit

config.name: precision
config.label: Precision
config.description: The number of decimal places. If not set, it is chosen based on the value

config.name: min
config.label: Min Value
config.description: The value of an empty bar, e.g. 30 for a temperature. Defaults to 0

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: The value of a full bar. If not set, percentages and °C temperatures use 100 and other metrics use their highest recorded value. Set it for metrics without a fixed range, such as clocks or power

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: Use a monospace font for the best result. Defaults to Cascadia Mono, Consolas or the system monospace font

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels. The widget width decides how many characters fit

config.name: theme
config.label: Theme
config.description: Color uses the htop and btop palette. Monochrome draws everything in one text color with reverse video headers, like plain top. Colors you set yourself are kept

config.name: text_color
config.label: Label
config.description: The color of the label

config.name: value_color
config.label: Value
config.description: The color of the value

config.name: bracket_color
config.label: Brackets
config.description: The color of the brackets in the htop style

config.name: empty_color
config.label: Empty
config.description: The color of the empty squares in the btop style

config.name: background_color
config.label: Background
config.description: The background color of the widget

config.name: color_mode
config.label: Color Mode
config.description: Gradient colors every cell by its position in the bar, Threshold colors the whole bar by the current value, Solid always uses the low color

config.name: color
config.label: Low Color
config.description: The color of a low load

config.name: warning_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of the max value at which the threshold mode switches to the warning color. Defaults to 50

config.name: warning_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of a medium load

config.name: critical_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of the max value at which the threshold mode switches to the critical color. Defaults to 80

config.name: critical_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of a high load
